items.question: Grafico comparando mortes de homens e mulheres nos ultimos 5 anos

chart_plan.reason: structured chart parameters extracted before SQL generation
chart_plan.sql_shape_guidance: Return tidy long rows with columns: ano, sexo, total_mortes. Group by ano and sexo so each year has one row per sex. For 'sexo', emit human-readable labels via CASE WHEN "SEXO"=1 THEN 'Masculino' WHEN "SEXO"=3 THEN 'Feminino' END, not raw codes. For the time window: take the last 5 available years anchored on MAX(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM DT_INTER)) from internacoes, then keep all years where EXTRACT(YEAR FROM DT_INTER) >= MAX_YEAR - 4. Do not collapse to a single year and do not use CURRENT_DATE/NOW().

trace.generated_chart_sql: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i."DT_INTER") AS ano, CASE WHEN i."SEXO" = 1 THEN 'Masculino' WHEN i."SEXO" = 3 THEN 'Feminino' ELSE 'Ignorado' END AS sexo, COUNT(*) AS total_mortes FROM internacoes i  WHERE i."DT_INTER" IS NOT NULL AND i."SEXO" IN (1, 3) AND i."MORTE" = true AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i."DT_INTER") >= (SELECT MAX(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "DT_INTER")) FROM internacoes) - 4 GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i."DT_INTER"), CASE WHEN i."SEXO" = 1 THEN 'Masculino' WHEN i."SEXO" = 3 THEN 'Feminino' ELSE 'Ignorado' END ORDER BY ano ASC;
